peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 19.3% below its local comparables; 4 of 36 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (11.8): 1.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 6 of 55 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 20.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,438,000 ($1,549 psf, 1,205–1,614 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,919 psf (range $1,768–1,946); 19.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $582,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Telok Blangah MRT about 210 m, Labrador Park MRT about 680 m; closer than 42 of 63 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 2 within 2 km; nearest Blangah Rise Primary School about 460 m; more than 17 of 63 similar developments (the same as 19). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 160 m), more than 1 of 63 similar developments (the same as 13); nearest hawker centre Telok Blangah Hawker Centre & Market about 140 m; nearest park Mount Faber Park about 380 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Terra Hill, 98 new sales, about 1,910 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 19 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 98 new sales and 185 resales (283 purchases); new sales were 34.6% of these purchases. Subsales (22) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Telok Blangah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 570 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 185 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 1 of 63 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 185 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 242 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−23.6%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
